identity: Poet and human rights defender · Australia · 1915–2000
title: Judith Wright's birth chart
metaDescription: Judith Wright's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 8.6° Gemini. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Cancer — Mercury, Saturn, Neptune and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 8.6° of Gemini is the Sun's exact seat — first decan, 0°–10°, sub-ruled by Mercury in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 1.8° Cancer, Venus was at 10.8° Taurus, Mars was at 3.7° Taurus. Read together: thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction that grows by reliability; effort banked steadily until it tells.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Mercury to Saturn, a conjunction with 0.5° of slack. Two bodies in the same degree are not read as neighbours but as a merger: whatever one wants, the other is already funding. Behind it, Mercury conjunction Pluto at 0.6°, and Saturn conjunction Pluto at 1.1° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags five placements in this chart. The Moon in Capricorn at 9.6° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Venus in Taurus at 10.8° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mars in Taurus at 3.7° is in detriment; Jupiter in Pisces at 24.8° is in domicile; Saturn in Cancer at 2.3° is in detriment. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The honest balance sheet uses the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: water 5, earth 3, air 2 across the elements, and cardinal 5, fixed 3, mutable 2 across the modalities. A water emphasis reads as porousness: the room is registered whole, long before it is analysed in parts. No settled placement falls in fire — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Uranus was retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Capricorn for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.8° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 9.6°.
